---
name: Spec clarification
about: Ask about a section of the spec that's ambiguous, contradictory, or doesn't cover a case you hit
title: "[spec] "
labels: ["spec"]
assignees: []
---

## Section involved

Link to or quote the spec section (in this repo's README, or in the linked design doc at `thebestmensch/home-lab`).

## What's unclear

What does the spec say? What's the ambiguity, contradiction, or missing case?

## Concrete scenario

What were you trying to do when you noticed this? A worked example beats abstract description.

## Proposed clarification (optional)

If you have a specific phrasing or rule that would resolve it, suggest it here. The maintainer may take it directly or rework it.

---

For consumer-tool integration questions, use the *Consumer tool integration* template instead.
For security issues, see [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) — please email, don't open a public issue.
